tokenize_text: tokenize a string of text using the LaserTokenizer with SentencePiece encoding and punctuation normalization
tokenize_file: tokenize an input text file line by line and write the tokenized output to a new file
tokenize_batch: tokenize a batch of text strings and return a list of tokenized strings
convert_ids_to_tokens: convert a list of token IDs back to their corresponding token strings using the SentencePiece decoder
initialize_tokenizer: initialize a LaserTokenizer by downloading the appropriate SentencePiece model for a given language and LASER version
